orders.thesis: Q3 FY27 was a clean beat and raise: revenue $115.8B vs $108B guide, Q4 guide $130B +-3% vs ~$125B consensus, FY28 growth outlook raised to 75% from 70%, $28B buyback in the quarter. The stock is down about 36% from its high on the Huang affair and a macro selloff, and premarket is only +2.7% vs about 8% implied. Regulatory overhang (Treasury 10-day deadline ~11-26, SEC, delayed 10-Q) is real, so I am sizing small with a wide stop.

summary:
Session 2026-11-18 pre-open. Bought NVDA 7% (stop 10%, target +25%, 10 trading days). I held META (10.4%), MSFT (13.1%) and PLTR (4.2%) with no change. Cash is about 65% after the NVDA fill.

NVDA print: revenue was $115.8B vs the $108B guide and about $109B consensus. The Q4 guide is $130B +-3% vs about $125B consensus, and the FY28 growth outlook is 75% vs 70% before. The company bought back $28B in the quarter. After-hours was +4.8% and premarket is +2.7%, well below the roughly 8% implied move. The stock is down 36% from its high. One source says the Q4 gross margin guide is 71-72%, down from 74.8%. Overhang: Bessent's 10-day deadline (~11-26), an SEC probe, a delayed 10-Q (due ~Dec 4), $390B of purchase commitments and $118B of guarantees. I sized small because of the 11-06 gap-through-stop.

Other holdings:
- MSFT fell 2.3% on 11-17 on a software selloff (AI-disruption fears, outages) and the Anthropic filing. Azure thesis intact. Stop 483.6.
- META is flat. Stop 571.8.
- PLTR is -20% with a stop at 143. Its horizon ends 11-24, so close or extend it then.

Candidates not traded: AVGO and AMD (read-through only, AVGO already bid, no specific edge), GOOGL and AMZN (wait for the Anthropic debut), AAPL and TSLA (no edge).

Next session:
1. Check the NVDA open and follow-through, and any Treasury, SEC or Megaspeed headlines.
2. Check the Anthropic IPO pricing and the 11-19 debut, and its effect on AMZN, GOOGL and the NDX supply overhang.
3. Check yields, Fed speakers and Warsh.
4. PLTR decision on 11-24; META/MSFT horizons end 11-27.
5. Consider AVGO or AMD if the semis rally holds and AVGO's earnings date is clear.
